annotations.title: Search assets, completed sales, planning and market profiles

description:
Bounded public search using the versioned SearchQuery. Criteria are validated by the server; sorting and pagination use the same eligibility as the map. All Entities returns separate groups. No graph inference or unknown evidence changes eligibility.

    QUERY SHAPE — `query` is one object:
      {"entity": "land",
       "geography": {"kind": "area", "id": "Kettering"},
       "criteria": {"parcel_area": {"min": 5000, "max": 9000}},
       "sort": "<a sort key>"}
    `geography` is {"kind": "area", "id": <area UUID, code or exact name>} or {"kind": "polygon", "geometry": <GeoJSON Polygon>}. Refinements go in `criteria`, an object keyed by refinement (not a list, not `filters`/`refinements`). `limit` and `cursor` are arguments of this tool, not of the query.

    Families (`query.entity`): Assets — `properties`, `buildings`, `land`, `listings`; Activity — `transactions` (HM Land Registry completed sales matched to a property) and `planning_applications` (official publishers only); Markets — `market_profiles` (one record per area × residential bedroom cohort with the selected `measure`'s latest value and observed trend; open one with `market_profile`). `market_facts` remains for existing observation ids but is superseded by `market_profiles`. Call `entity_search_capabilities` for each family's refinements and sorts. Free.. Actors — `owners` (companies that own homes in the place, ranked by holdings; companies only, signed-in account required, not the shared preview) and `agents` (estate and letting agents by listing activity in a trailing window). Owners and agents are searched on their own, not inside All Entities.

SearchGeography.description: Where to search: a named area or a drawn polygon.

geometry.description: kind "polygon": a GeoJSON Polygon, one closed outer ring in [lng, lat] order: {"type": "Polygon", "coordinates": [[[-0.22, 51.49], [-0.19, 51.49], [-0.19, 51.51], [-0.22, 51.51], [-0.22, 51.49]]]}.

id.description: kind "area": the area's UUID (`area_id` from `area_resolve`), its code ("E07000153", "SW11") or its exact name ("Kettering").
id.title: Id

kind.description: "area" for a named place; "polygon" for a drawn boundary.

SearchQuery.description: What to search: one family, where, and its refinements.

criteria.description: Refinements, an OBJECT keyed by refinement: a range is {"min": .., "max": ..} (inclusive, either bound optional), a choice is a list of allowed values, a date range is {"min": "YYYY-MM-DD", "max": "YYYY-MM-DD"}. Keys and values per family come from `entity_search_capabilities`. e.g. {"parcel_area": {"min": 5000, "max": 9000}, "built_coverage": {"max": 10}}.

description.description: Listings only: a short written preference to rank by.

sort.description: A sort key the family lists in `entity_search_capabilities`. "relevance" only with `description`.
